title: Event envelope
description: Body of every message published to umir.events and umir.auth. The event type is not in the body: it travels in the AMQP property type (<owner>.<eventType>). The object is closed, so personal data, one-time codes, tokens and message texts cannot be added by accident.

eventID.description: Opaque string, at most 256 characters, unique within the owner. A UUID is not required. It is not outbox.id, which is the UUID of the outbox row.

owner.description: Service that produced the event. Serving and Feedback publish no events.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this envelope and of the event type.

restaurantID.description: Required for warehouse.*; absent in organization-level auth events.

aggregateRevision.description: warehouse.*: version of the restaurant stream, gap-free within a generation. auth.*: monotonic but not gap-free.

generation.description: Storage generation of the owner at the time of the event.

correlationID.description: Trace identifier: up to 256 code points, no control characters (C60). Warehouse puts the client commandID in causationID, so spaces and non-ASCII characters are allowed.

causationID.description: Trace identifier: up to 256 code points, no control characters (C60). Warehouse puts the client commandID in causationID, so spaces and non-ASCII characters are allowed.

topics.description: Live topics the event refreshes. Required for warehouse.*, not allowed for auth.*.
